lessonRef.title: Explicit model: packing a bag ahead

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 5 — time, belongings, and help-seeking
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice packing a bag ahead. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: The night before a lesson day, the learner checks tomorrow's written plan or a spoken reminder from an adult, gathers exactly what tomorrow requires into one bag rather than packing everything they own just in case, and sets the finished bag by the door used to leave the house.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe one specific item that was easy to forget in the past and what about tonight's process helped you remember to pack it this time.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Item selection accuracy: Packs all items tomorrow's plan requires, with at most one item added at the morning check. | Timing of the routine: The bag is fully packed and placed by the door the night before. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner pack a bag ahead for a two-day plan, sorting on paper which items are needed both days versus needed on only one of the two days.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice packing a bag ahead. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.elapsedWindow: Two short sessions across one day; no continuous monitoring
duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: one bag or backpack
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: packing a bag ahead worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The night before a lesson day, the learner checks tomorrow's written plan or a spoken reminder from an adult, gathers exactly what tomorrow requires into one bag rather than packing everything they own just in case, and sets the finished bag by the door used to leave the house.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact packing a bag ahead decision or action.
Model move 2: Before packing, look closely at tomorrow's plan.
Model move 3: Working from your list, gather each item one at a time and pack it directly into the bag before moving to the next item.

Model check: Item selection accuracy: Packs all items tomorrow's plan requires, with at most one item added at the morning check. | Timing of the routine: The bag is fully packed and placed by the door the night before.

resources.title: packing a bag ahead action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for packing a bag ahead.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: packing a bag ahead coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The night before a lesson day, the learner checks tomorrow's written plan or a spoken reminder from an adult, gathers exactly what tomorrow requires into one bag rather than packing everything they own just in case, and sets the finished bag by the door used to leave the house.
Coach direction: Before packing, look closely at tomorrow's plan.
Learner prompt: List the three or four specific things tomorrow's plan says you will need.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: packing a bag ahead complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Working from your list, gather each item one at a time and pack it directly into the bag before moving to the next item.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I checked tomorrow's plan before picking up a single item.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I checked the weather, or asked an adult about it, before choosing a weather-based item.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I placed each item directly into the bag, not set down next to it.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I set the packed bag by the exit door once every item was inside.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: packing a bag ahead minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe one specific item that was easy to forget in the past and what about tonight's process helped you remember to pack it this time.

Success checks: Item selection accuracy: Packs all items tomorrow's plan requires, with at most one item added at the morning check. | Timing of the routine: The bag is fully packed and placed by the door the night before.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: packing a bag ahead supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional packing a bag ahead condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Item selection accuracy: Packs all items tomorrow's plan requires, with at most one item added at the morning check. | Timing of the routine: The bag is fully packed and placed by the door the night before..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guidedFirstAttempt.setup: The night before a lesson day, the learner checks tomorrow's written plan or a spoken reminder from an adult, gathers exactly what tomorrow requires into one bag rather than packing everything they own just in case, and sets the finished bag by the door used to leave the house.

Point to one model step only.

simulationRoute.title: packing a bag ahead — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the packing a bag ahead task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Describe one specific item that was easy to forget in the past and what about tonight's process helped you remember to pack it this time.
observableCriteria: Item selection accuracy: Packs all items tomorrow's plan requires, with at most one item added at the morning check.
Timing of the routine: The bag is fully packed and placed by the door the night before.

account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Item selection accuracy: Packs all items tomorrow's plan requires, with at most one item added at the morning check. | Timing of the routine: The bag is fully packed and placed by the door the night before.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
